# IntelliJ IDEA Enterprise Architecture & Refactoring

Maximize development velocity and code quality in IntelliJ IDEA for JVM and polyglot systems.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Store shared inspection profiles and code style configurations under `.idea/inspectionProfiles`.
- Delegate build, test, and run actions to Maven/Gradle to prevent IDE vs CI build discrepancies.
- Automate repetitive code migrations using Structural Search and Replace (SSR) templates.
- Profile runtime heap allocations and thread states using IntelliJ's built-in memory profiler.
